service.name: Dragonsong’s Reprise (Ultimate)
service.longDescription: “There are no ifs in history, yet man is wont to cast his mind towards the path not walked.” Thus spoke the wandering minstrel, and at his urging, you reflect upon bygone trials with newfound perspective. Your imagination stirred by the man's masterfully woven verse, you dream of an alternate conclusion to the Dragonsong War─one in which a dear comrade is spared his tragic fate...

rewards.title: Dragonsong Totem
rewards.text: Ultimate-specific totems that can be exchanged for a weapon of your choosing.

rewards.title: The Heavens' Legend
rewards.text: Exclusive title acquired from completing the duty.

rewards.title: Achievement: “As Suits a Hero”
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon defeating King Thordan in Dragonsong's Reprise.
